references.text: Describes the same event where the disciples see Jesus walking on water and are afraid, and later ask him to come aboard.
Mark's parallel account of Jesus walking on the sea, the disciples' fear, and Jesus reassuring them with the words 'Do not be afraid'.
Describes sailors experiencing a storm and fear at sea, before God calms the storm and brings them safely to harbor—a motif that mirrors the disciples' experience.
Describes God's path through the sea and his power over the waters, a theme central when Jesus walks on the sea in John 6.
